messages:
jess: Hey team, customer reported intermittent 403s on embeddings only after they deployed our k8s sidecar. Happening ~2x/day, other gen endpoints OK. logs attached: `401`/`403` entries.

maya: Can you share the request headers (sanitized) and the key type? customer says they're using a service-account token minted by our provisioner.

jess: Sent sample header: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***`, scope claim in token: `\"scopes\": \"infer,embeddings\"` (jwt payload). They said sidecar does some header rewrite in nginx.

maya: Interesting — if token claim is `infer,embeddings` (comma) that should be fine; our authN expects a list. Raj, does provisioner normalize commas vs spaces?

raj: quick check — older provisioner versions parsed scopes by splitting on whitespace only. Comma-delimited tokens would be treated as a single scope `infer,embeddings` -> not matched -> deny :grimacing:

jess: That matches customer symptom: embeddings denied (403) but gen allowed on other key? Wait they said gen is allowed. How would that be allowed if parsing failed?

raj: They have two keys in rotation. Sometimes sidecar drops header so fallback key (full-scoped) used. Intermittent depending on pod restart. Logs show `scope_match=false` for svcacct id `svc-123` around failures.

liam: I've pulled repro cluster from customer. I can reproduce 403 using our test client with Authorization header set to token containing `\"scopes\":\"infer,embeddings\"`.

liam: Repro snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"input":"foo"}' \\n  https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings
```
response: `{"error": "403 Unauthorized: missing scopes: embeddings"}`

maya: Ok root cause likely provisioner emitted comma-separated scopes and the auth layer expects space-separated. Customer's sidecar preserved token but didn't change commas.

raj: Patch ready: change scope parsing to split on `[ ,]+` (commas or whitespace) and normalize lower-case. Also add a unit test for tokens with commas and semicolons.

provisioner-bot: deploy started for `auth-service` -> rollout id `rl-579` (canary 10%) :rocket:

jess: Customer notified: "we found root cause; rolling a fix now; temporary workaround: rotate their service token via console to get normalized scopes" — waiting on canary results before full rollout.

liam: Canary 10% looks good, no 403s in synthetic tests. Planning 100% in 15m if no regressions.

maya: After rollout, we should provide a postmortem and a checklist for provisioning tokens from k8s sidecars (ensure header passthrough). Also add an alert: sudden spike in `scope_match=false` auth failures.

jess: Customer applied rotation workaround and reports no failures in last 30m. Marking as resolved for now, will follow up with PM for long-term fix.

raj: I'll open a small RFC to update provisioner to emit space-separated scopes and add server-side tolerant parsing. Also will backport patch to v1.4.x for customers on older infra.

jess: Thanks everyone :heart: closing thread after PM follow-up.
